name: PlainDental
subtitle: Dental health, plain language
shortDescription: PlainDental makes dental health easy to understand — conditions, care routines, emergencies, and costs explained in plain language. No jargon, no confusion.
longDescription:
PlainDental explains dental health in plain, jargon-free language — so you can understand your teeth, conditions, and treatment options without a medical degree.

### What's Inside
Dental Conditions — Learn about 16 conditions including cavities, gum disease, TMJ, sensitivity, and more. Each with causes, symptoms, treatment options, and
  prevention tips.

Dental Procedures — Understand 12 common procedures step by step: fillings, crowns, root canals, implants, braces, whitening, and more. Includes duration, pain
  level, recovery time, and 2026 cost estimates.

Emergency Guide — Immediate guidance for 8 dental emergencies: knocked-out tooth, cracked tooth, severe pain, abscess, bleeding gums, jaw injury, lost filling,
  and objects stuck between teeth. All free.

Interactive Tooth Map — Tap any of 32 adult teeth to learn its name, type, position, and function. Realistic tooth shapes with universal numbering system.

Oral Hygiene — Proper brushing, flossing, mouthwash use, and diet impact on dental health.

Kids' Dental — Age-specific guidance: teething, first dental visit, thumb sucking, sealants, orthodontic timing, cavity prevention, and fluoride treatments.

Dental Glossary — 100+ dental terms explained in plain language. Searchable.

Cost Guide — Typical costs for common procedures with insurance coverage info and money-saving tips.

Pre-Visit Prep — What to expect and questions to ask for 6 types of dental visits.

Condition Comparisons — Side-by-side comparisons of similar conditions and treatments.

### Disclaimer
PlainDental is for educational purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional dental advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified dental
  professional.
